description: Finds papers across the enabled sources, stores and enriches them, and represents each one (facets, vectors, citations) for similarity search.

papers.source.description: A paper source searched by every sweep and by search_papers. Built-in ids: arxiv, openalex, europepmc, semanticscholar; other ids are served by the contributing plugin's exported sources[id].

papers.enricher.description: Completes stored records (venue, citations, references) after a search.

papers.embedder.description: Turns paper text into vectors; changing it re-computes vectors in the background.

chatTools.name: search_papers
chatTools.description: Search the enabled paper sources; results are stored in the project.

query.description: Search terms, at most 200 characters; quote phrases

since.description: Only papers published on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD)
